cadastro.explicacao: Name is the only required info — the rest is optional and helps us understand who uses KnowRa.

pergunte.texto: No category, no form — just type what made you curious and click Ask.

resposta.texto: KnowRa's AI explains it clearly, no jargon — in a way any curious person can understand.

desafio.texto: After the answer, you can test whether you really understood — no obligation, no penalty for getting it wrong.

xp.texto: Your answer is really evaluated — the more you show you learned, the more XP you earn.

evolucao.texto: Level, day streak and achievements are always visible. Edit your info anytime in Profile, and see your mastery by area in the Knowledge Map.

exemplo.resposta: The sky is blue because of Rayleigh scattering — sunlight scatters more in blue than in other colors as it passes through the atmosphere. That's why the sky doesn't look purple or green, even though those colors are also present in sunlight.
exemplo.desafio: Explain in your own words why the sky isn't red.
